_doc: S8-014: advisories that do not block CI. Each needs the reason it does not apply, an owner and a review date within 90 days. Reviewed at every release audit.

allow.reason: Dev-server-only path traversal / optimized-deps .map handling; production is static files with no dev server. Cleared by the planned Vite 8 major.
Dev-server request exposure; the build output is static. Cleared with the Vite 8 major.
Open redirect via // or backslash in <Link>/useNavigate; the app never navigates to user-supplied paths (routes come from typed data). Cleared by the React Router 7 major.
